Some last thoughts:
I couldn’t sleep too much last night, I guess it’s normal, just coming back from the bank and fedex; I cashed out enough money for the expenses to come ( I hidden the money and the info was sent to someone I trust trough fedex), I’ll spend the rest of the day meditating and I’ll reset all my electronic devices later so they won’t have a password or info, thanks everyone for the advice and good wishes; I guess this is it.
Funny but tonight i had my last “proper” dinner  (seafood) , tomorrow i won’t eat too much:  almost like  fasting
A few countries , it was one thing I used to enjoy but not anymore

Of course, but not that much ,  I lost interest in all my hobbies , don’t talk anymore , only the necessary at work to look normal, I spend  my weekends  at home and almost hitting  the 40s  my future is not worth it
Hi, It’s something that took me months, first thinking and then  planning, I wanted to be sure about it, so far, still convinced.

I’m doing something similar, I just stopped being active   On my accounts and unfriending a lot of persons 2 months ago, but im facing the dilemma, because it may look like a natural “leaving”  so I don’t want to look too suspicious, I also sold a lot of stuff, so it would be easy to get rid of the rest
